coldStartingState: reload document for every lesson and round; no transient original-open/selected-line map from prior lesson successes

freshTasks.blockchain: なぜ届いたブロックをそのまま記録せず確かめるか。原文で一つの確認を示す。
freshTasks.ethereum: 状態とは何か。取引を実行する処理と記録する処理の根拠を示す。
freshTasks.rpc: RPCで取引を送ると何を受け取り、成功時に何が終わっているか。
freshTasks.reth: Rethの主な担当を追う。届いたブロックの検証・実行と返答、採用する履歴を更新する別の要求、採用後に保存する条件と完了通知が、それぞれどうつながるかをコードで説明する。
freshTasks.send: 受信した署名済み取引がプールへ入る通常経路の入力・主要分岐・結果と返答元を追う。
freshTasks.startup: 起動入口から動き続ける処理へつながる担当を追い、待つ箇所と止まる条件を説明する。
freshTasks.reading: 実コードの受け取る値、主要な処理、返す結果を見つけ、関連実装を読んで元へ戻る。

freshness: First novice round uses a newly delegated AI without implementation/history. Its second round is repeated exposure and is labelled so; no AI result is human evidence. Source/UI reviewers are warm reviewers.

reth.old: Rethの主な担当を、受信・検証/実行・保存・応答のつながりとしてコードで追う。
reth.reason: Old prompt could suggest one serial NewPayload-to-save-to-reply chain. These are distinct input/response paths. Preserve first partial result; revised task is a new explicit protocol, never a strict same-task improvement claim.

taskChange.others: Original wording and max10 preserved. An additional primary path cannot substitute for page-wide evidence or branch understanding.

recordEachTask: actual start URL, runtime/data/config hashes and profile
cold reload per lesson and round
each counted action with label/target and timestamp
answer in own words with observed file/line evidence
unread branches, unresolved questions, attempts beyond cap are not success
source-open count and selected original/comment geometry after explicit navigation
first failure retained; retries/new runtime are separate observations

additionalGates.R1: new/first cold focus opens one primary original per scope; automatic call following at most3; explicit parallel not counted as automatic
additionalGates.R2: Each active source has current role and same-page next/previous/picker; actual call vs asynchronous request/reply vs related reading labelled distinctly; call/back restores origin selection/URL/draft
additionalGates.R3: All personas can manually choose focus/parallel and each of four symbol-list/comment settings; manual state persists on same-question rerender/preferences; initial explicit destination wins only on fresh explicit request
additionalGates.R4: Original108 owner G1-G6 all applicable pairs and all affected producers/replicas checked twice on one frozen candidate; every published context (current148 plus any reviewed additions) individually four states twice; Rust native all purpose-specific contexts local/static four states twice, Atlas route/payload preserved
additionalGates.R5: Actual original row and all adjacent authored comments, when enabled and fitting available space, fully visible inside code pane and browser safe viewport after explicit entry/call/back/previous/next/phase/picker. Record dimensions and sticky occlusion; impossible fit needs review, never DOM-nonhidden PASS. One compact navigator per logical scope. Cold concept intro does not auto-skip. Manual editor/raw priority and focus preserved.
additionalGates.R6: All7 lessons identify main question and meaning-based primary reading order without shrinking original source ranges or hiding existing explanation claims. Every original/detail remains reachable same page in one deliberate selection; in-function landmarks point to actual conditions/results. Priority is independent of existing essential/technical flags. No straight arrow invented across separate inputs.

stateMatrix.generic: Every source context on its actual generic consumer, each4 states,2 rounds. Additional nonrepresentative contexts are counted explicitly.
stateMatrix.rust: All native purpose contexts across5 topics including batch runner on local and static,4 states,2 rounds. Atlas21 Rust route payloads and42 URL variants remain separate.
stateMatrix.conditional: same asset bytes, explicitly configured late data and fetch failure; editor/raw focus and keyboard retry restoration. Failure retry is not successful recovery evidence.
stateMatrix.viewport: R5 producer/action/profile/control cross-product applicability inventory fixed before formal freeze; no representative producer generalization; actual sizes only. Narrow viewport unmeasured unless safely available in own test surface.

separateEvidence: whole-code coverage (not achieved; inventory denominator retained)
acceptance: Functional loop complete only after every applicable fixed criterion passes two rounds on same frozen runtime/data/config. Any fail or not-measured keeps incomplete. Whole Reth and human learning remain separate unmet goals.
metadataCorrection: Before formal freeze: restore original task string accidentally aliased in protocol authoring; original candidate7 and fresh5 evidence unchanged.
